body:
First of all, excuse my english, I´m not a native speaker.
I have used a lot of 'soft' drugs, and use to smoke pot almost daily, and nothing compares to tramadol.
I discovered tramadol after a dental surgery 6 years ago but didn´t consider it for recreational use, but last year I had another, more serious surgery and remembered that it was an excellent painkiller so I asked for it to my MD.
That´s when I began to enjoy the drug. It takes the pain away and many more...
When I take the pill it takes like one hour to make the magic, It creates a wonderfull mix of wellness, euphoria and relaxation with waves of pleasure that goes trough my head every few minutes... heaven in a pill.
I can stay and enjoy the music or a movie or go to work, for a walk or whatever, everything will be more enjoyable than usual. I can be fully functional and no one would tell I was high as fuck, maybe in a better mood.
The effects are surprisingly long lasting, after 12 hours are still there and even the next moring I can still notice some 'trama happines' that last some hours
Another effect is delayed ejaculation but sex is very pleasant.
I don´t like
mixing it with pot, for me it causes instant dizziness and nausea, some alcohol is ok, a lot is bad idea. In my case just the tramadol effects are so good that I don´t need anything more.
I have shared some of my pills with friends and the effects changes a lot between different people, some suffer dizziness or nausea and some don´t feel all the good effects.
I think this substance has a very high adiction potential so I only take it once a week, sometimes two, to minimize the risks of tolerance or adiction. It seems to work, I still have a good high with just 150mg.
I am grateful for not discover this drug when I was younger, now I can manage it responsibly but it´s so good that I´m sure I would be adicted to it if had tried it at 20´s
Aditional info:
Not good for driving
some nose itching
